tasks.short: Select and edit archival documents for publication

steps.what: Find actual candidate documents and their provenance, descriptions and existing access/rights records in the archival collection-management system {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing archival records and source documents
outputs: Original candidate documents and linked provenance/rights records

steps.what: Select actual documents for publication or display by reading the originals and applying subject knowledge, provenance, audience needs and actual publication rights or restrictions.
inputs: Original documents and records from s1
outputs: Actual selected documents, permitted scope and editorial intent

steps.what: Edit the publication/display copy for literary expression and readability in {DOCS}, keeping original quotations distinct and making all proposed wording changes visible against the actual selected source.
inputs: Actual selected source documents and editorial intent from s2
Exact permitted passages and house style
outputs: Tracked editorial-copy draft with source-linked proposed changes

loop.purpose: Propose source-grounded readability edits to the editorial copy, never the archival original
loop.input: Actual selected passages, permitted scope and editorial intent from s2
loop.output: Tracked proposed wording with source passage links and explicit uncertainty
loop.check: Every factual assertion and quotation is compared to the original; archivist accepts or rejects meaning-sensitive edits and checks the finished layout in s6
loop.stop: One draft and at most one correction pass; unsupported assertions, unclear quotations or disputed meaning go to manual editing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native styles handle layout but cannot propose context-sensitive literary wording; use the loop only for actual prose editing after native formatting is tested

steps.what: Apply the required publication/display headings, citation fields and paragraph styles to the actual edited copy in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual tracked editorial copy from s3
Existing house-style template and source identifiers
outputs: Complete styled draft preserving original-source links

steps.what: Refine actual document presentation for the intended publication or display, adjusting image placement, reading sequence and accessibility in the final layout draft {DOCS}.

Check and correct the complete final publication/display version against original documents, subject meaning, quotations, literary expression, provenance, restrictions, presentation and exact release destination.
inputs: Original selected documents and provenance/rights records
outputs: Exact checked final version and release destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked final publication/display copy in {DOCS} without altering the archival originals.
inputs: Exact completed version checked in s6

steps.what: Release the exact checked final document copy to the designated publication/display destination in {CMS}.
inputs: Unchanged final copy saved in s7
Exact release destination checked in s6

tasks.design: Start with native collection views and document styles. Add a bounded tracked-edit proposal only for actual prose editing; the archivist selects sources and checks every meaning-sensitive change. Finish all layout work before reviewing the final version, then separately save and release it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual source navigation, repeated style application and first-pass literary edits around substantive archival judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata/style features and a constrained source-linked editorial draft.
tasks.still_hard: Historical meaning, provenance, rights and misleading editorial changes.
tasks.human_edge: Select and present archival material without erasing context or changing what the original says.

ambition.what: Prepare a readable version for a different actual audience while retaining original quotations and provenance.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical editing effort, with more attention to source meaning and access boundaries.

reach.learn: Separate editorial wording from original evidence

evidence.claim: Native styles can handle repeated presentation, while bounded prose proposals require source-by-source human validation before archival publication.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured archival baselines. Boundary includes actual selection, editing, final presentation, save and digital release. Physical exhibit installation and original-document conservation are unchanged separate work, not replaced by CMS release.

Existing archival staff supply descriptions, provenance and rights records through their unchanged collection workflow. The archivist obtains and reads actual originals in s1-s2 and supplies actual editorial intent before s3. Missing or restricted source material is manually resolved or excluded; no free digitisation, transcription or inferred rights clearance.

Test native views/styles first. s4 replaces an actual remaining manual style/field application and receives no saving where already automatic. s3 is optional: source meaning or unresolved text returns to full manual editing, reducing gain. Original archival records and quotations are not rewritten by the model.

All layout and corrections finish before s6 checks the exact final version. Ordinary completed-version checks supply requested save/release gates without added self-approval labour. Any revision, including a later editor's revision, requires renewed final checking before release. The 1% same-system save and 1% release are fully retained with zero saving; no existing runtime benefit.
unknowns: Permission for a confidential editorial draft
research_questions: Do tracked suggestions preserve original meaning and make every unsupported claim visible before the final layout is released?

already_counted.description: Residual retrieval/editing, actual selection, layout judgment, full source/rights review, save and release remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source links, styles and sampled checks for unsupported editorial changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed final layout and document copy checked in s6
Unchanged final copy and publication/display destination checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*.35+25*.35+10=22.25 gross less 2 upkeep gives 20.25, rounded down. Zero if native functions already remove clerical work and prose proposals require full manual editing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: More attention to archival meaning, access and presentation rather than repeated source navigation and mechanical editing.
role.ambitious_version: An archivist who makes material accessible while preserving a clear boundary between original evidence and editorial presentation.
